title: ZXTank Collectables
seoTitle: ZXTank Collectables | Battlefield Power-Ups | BarkinMad Studios
description: Discover the temporary collectables available in ZXTank, including weapon upgrades, mobility boosts, defensive equipment and tactical battlefield support.
summary: Battlefield collectables provide temporary advantages that can completely change the outcome of a battle.
heroImageAlt: Illustration representing battlefield collectables in ZXTank

sections.heading: Battlefield Collectables
paragraphs: Collectables appear throughout the battlefield and reward players who are prepared to take calculated risks. Unlike repair salvage, collectables provide temporary upgrades that enhance your tank's performance during battle.
Knowing when to leave cover to collect an upgrade can often be the difference between victory and defeat.

sections.heading: Weapon Upgrades
paragraphs: Weapon collectables temporarily improve your firepower, allowing you to deal greater damage or gain new offensive abilities.
Examples include High-Power Shells, Rapid Loader and other specialist ammunition designed to give you an advantage during intense firefights.

sections.heading: Mobility Upgrades
paragraphs: Mobility upgrades improve your ability to move around the battlefield, helping you reach strategic locations, escape danger or reposition more quickly.
These upgrades enhance movement while still respecting the condition of your tank's engine and tracks.

sections.heading: Defensive Upgrades
paragraphs: Defensive collectables help your tank survive longer by reducing incoming damage or providing temporary protection during combat.
Using defensive upgrades at the right moment can keep your tank operational long enough to recover, repair or complete an objective.

sections.heading: Intelligence Upgrades
paragraphs: Battlefield awareness is just as important as firepower. Intelligence collectables improve your ability to locate enemies and react to changing situations.
Enhanced radar information can reveal opportunities to ambush opponents, avoid danger or secure important objectives.

sections.heading: Utility Upgrades
paragraphs: Utility collectables provide unique tactical advantages that do not fit into the traditional weapon or defence categories.
These upgrades can improve battlefield recovery, increase salvage collection efficiency or provide other strategic benefits.

sections.heading: Worth Fighting For
paragraphs: Collectables are available to every commander. Once they appear, they become valuable objectives that often draw multiple tanks into the same area.
Choosing the right moment to collect an upgrade is just as important as deciding which upgrade to pursue.

sections.heading: Growing Arsenal
paragraphs: The range of available collectables is expected to grow as ZXTank evolves, introducing new tactical possibilities while keeping every battle fresh and unpredictable.
Future updates may introduce additional weapon systems, defensive equipment and battlefield support abilities.
